## ✅ Self-Checklist

<!--- Put an `x` in all the boxes that apply. -->

### Build & Quality

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` completes successfully
- [ ] No new TypeScript `any` or `@ts-ignore` added (or justified below)
- [ ] No new `console.log` statements

### UI / UX (if UI change)

- [ ] Tested on mobile viewport (≤ 480px)
- [ ] Tested on tablet / desktop breakpoints
- [ ] Keyboard navigation still works (Tab, Enter, Esc)
- [ ] Focus states are visible
- [ ] Animation performance looks smooth (no jank)

### Documentation

- [ ] Relevant README sections updated
- [ ] Changed / added files have appropriate docstrings / comments
- [ ] If new env var: added to `.env.example` + README Environment Variables table
- [ ] If new folder / pattern: mentioned in `docs/folder-structure.md`

### Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation only / no code change
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization
- [ ] ♿ Accessibility improvement
- [ ] 🧹 Refactor (no behavior change)
